title: Retesting alerts (Pranav Saxena, 2021 GSoC)
description: The Retest add-on's first commit and release in August 2021, its later history, and the contributor's other commits in zaproxy and zap-extensions that year.

chapters.title: The Hall of Fame entry and the launch post
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Pranav Saxena for "Retesting Alerts", GSoC, 2021 Summer, with blog and add-on links. The blog post, dated 2021-08-23, describes generating a Retest Plan from selected alerts, a Verify button, running the plan in the Automation Framework, and a Retest API. It says retesting authenticated alerts is not yet supported.

chapters.title: Earlier 2021 commits by pranavsaxena17
chapters.text: The commit author handle pranavsaxena17 appears on commits in zap-extensions and zaproxy from March 2021; the handle is matched to the student by similarity only. Examples in zap-extensions: "Introduce DiceMatcher to replace HirshbergMatcher in scan rules" (2021-05-03), "Add variable support for automation framework" (2021-05-07), "automation: Add new requestor Job" (2021-06-30) and "automation: Add alert tests" (2021-07-08). In zaproxy: "Added menu item to add the base URL to a context" (2021-04-24). The Hall of Fame entry is about retesting; the automation commits are the add-on that Retest builds on.

chapters.title: August 2021: first commit and first release
chapters.text: "Initial addon" by pranavsaxena17 is dated 2021-08-20 and creates addOns/retest (AlertData.java, retest.gradle.kts, CHANGELOG.md) while also editing the automation add-on. "Made minor tweaks to the automation and retest addon" follows on 2021-08-21. The changelog dates 0.0.1 on 2021-08-23, with "Allow retesting for the presence/absence of certain alerts using the Automation Framework."; thc202's "Trigger release of automation and retest" is dated the same day.

chapters.title: Since then
chapters.text: Later commits include "retest: fix plan generator" (2022-10-21), "retest: include HTTP version for requestor job" (2022-11-28), and "Move passive scan jobs to `pscan`" (2024-08-16). The changelog lists 0.9.0 (2024-05-07), 0.10.0 (2024-09-02) and 0.11.0 (2025-01-10), and the add-on is still under addOns/retest at HEAD with an unreleased change raising the minimum ZAP version to 2.17.0.
